title: 第901章 从长计议第900章 厚赏
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
司空唯我的赏赐一出，在场所有长老皆是心头一颤。
这份赏赐，厚重至极，乃是宗门顶级规格！
足以让一位天人境修士资源堆砌，一路突破至仙境！
凌宇微微躬身。
“谢掌教师兄赏赐！”
司空唯我目光转向一旁的柳惊天，继续开口。
“柳惊天听赏！”
“弟子在！”
“你先天剑体大成，此战杀伐镇妖，功不可没！”
“赐你剑道上古传承、千年剑髓、极品灵剑胚一柄！”
“赐你入宗门剑冢悟道三月，任选一柄上古残剑！”
柳惊天眼底闪过一抹亮色，郑重躬身谢恩。
“弟子谢宗主！”
两大赏赐落下，直接将两人的修行底蕴再度拔高一个层次。
有了这批顶级资源，凌宇足以全力炼制全新虚空导弹。
甚至借此打磨出更强的绝杀法器，补齐自身底牌短板。
柳惊天更是能借着剑冢悟道，突破自身剑道桎梏。
司空唯我看着二人，再度沉声开口，道出宗门后续规划。
“经此一战，长生天妖族彻底蛰伏，万族心生忌惮。”
“短时间之内，再无异族胆敢挑衅我太虚宗与人族威严。”

“但万族蛰伏，不代表危机消散。”
“域外大势动荡不休，各路至尊级强者暗流涌动。”
“尤其是即将跨界而来的星尊，不确定性极大。”
听到星尊二字，在场所有长老神色瞬间凝重。
他们身居宗门高层，远比普通弟子清楚域外秘辛。
星尊之力，可一怒覆灭一界，战力超脱常规认知。
又嫉恶如仇。
他们深怕门下弟子犯错，从而牵连宗门无辜。
因此，整片诸天万界，星尊成为最恐怖的不稳定因素之一。
太虚宗虽然不怕，但还是密切关注星尊的一举一动。
长生天可和蜕凡天不一样。
它是所有诸天万界各族各宗的中层核心。
它的成败，关系着诸天万界各族各宗的未来。
凌宇心中了然，瞬间明白妖庭隐忍退让的真正根源。
难怪涂山宁愿舍弃半壁妖族基业，也要强行忍下血海深仇。
相比于星尊灭世之危，四座妖城的损失，确实不值一提。
不过，他没想到。
content_en:
As soon as Sikong Weiwo's reward came out, all the elders present felt their hearts tremble.
This reward is extremely generous and is the top standard of the sect!
It’s enough for a monk in the heavenly realm to pile up resources and break through all the way to the fairyland!
Ling Yu bowed slightly.
"Thank you, Master Master, for the reward!"
Sikong Weiwo turned his eyes to Liu Jingtian who was aside and continued to speak.
"Liu Jingtian listens and appreciates it!"
"The disciple is here!"
"You have perfected your innate sword body, and you have contributed a lot to killing and suppressing demons in this battle!"
"I'll give you the ancient inheritance of swordsmanship, a thousand-year sword marrow, and a top-notch spiritual sword embryo!"
"I will grant you three months of enlightenment in the sect's sword tomb, and you can choose an ancient broken sword!"
Liu Jingtian's eyes flashed brightly, and he solemnly bowed to thank him.
"Disciple thanks the sect master!"
The two major rewards fell, which directly raised the two people's cultivation background to a higher level.
With these top-notch resources, Ling Yu is able to fully refine the new void missile.
It can even be used to polish a stronger magic weapon to make up for the shortcomings of one's own cards.
Liu Jingtian was even able to gain enlightenment through the Sword Tomb and break through the shackles of his own swordsmanship.
Sikong Weiwo looked at the two of them and spoke in a deep voice again, telling the sect's follow-up plans.
"After this battle, the Immortal Demon Clan has completely gone into hibernation, and all races are fearful."
"In a short period of time, no other alien race will dare to challenge the majesty of our Taixu Sect and the human race."
"But just because all races are dormant does not mean that the crisis has dissipated."
"The situation outside the territory is in constant turmoil, and there are undercurrents of supreme powerhouses from all walks of life."
"Especially for the Star Lord who is about to cross over, there is great uncertainty."
Upon hearing the word "Xingzun", all the elders present looked solemn.
They are at the top of the sect and know far more about the secrets of the outside world than ordinary disciples.
The power of the Star Lord can destroy an entire world in one rage, and his combat power is beyond conventional understanding.
He also hates evil as much as he hates it.
They are deeply afraid that their disciples will make mistakes and implicate the innocent sect.
Therefore, Star Lord has become one of the most terrifying unstable factors in the entire universe.
Although Taixu Sect was not afraid, he still paid close attention to Xing Zun's every move.
The Heaven of Immortality is different from the Heaven of Mortal Transformation.
It is the middle-level core of all races and sects in all heavens and realms.
Its success or failure is related to the future of all races and sects in the world.
Ling Yu understood in his heart, and instantly understood the real source of Yaoting's forbearance and retreat.
No wonder Tushan would rather give up half of the demon clan's foundation and endure the blood feud.
Compared with the danger of Star Lord's annihilation, the losses of the four demon cities are indeed nothing worth mentioning.
However, he didn't expect it.
